I added a log line to `refund()` in `src/billing/refunds.py`. It calls `log.info("refund", invoice_id=invoice.id)` at the top of the function, before the amount check. I haven't run the code or any tests.

I used `structlog` with a module-level `log = structlog.get_logger()`, because the project has a stored decision to use it instead of stdlib `logging`. `src/billing/invoices.py` already logs this way.

The line runs before validation, so a refund that fails the "exceeds invoice total" check is still logged. If you only want successful refunds logged, I can move it below the check.
